title: Shine a Light on Your Lawn at Night and Wolf Spiders Light Up
subject: wolf spider

scenes.text: Shine a flashlight over grass at night, and the ground stares back.
Those glowing dots are wolf spiders. They have eight eyes, and four have a mirror behind them.
That reflective layer sends light back through the eye, which helps them see in the dark.
They don't build webs. They run prey down, feeling the vibrations of wings and footsteps.
And the mother carries her egg sac, which can hold over 100 eggs, on her own abdomen.
When they hatch, the babies climb on her back, sometimes in layers.

description:
